integrity.claim_scope: Uniform independent pairwise arithmetic averaging on K_{1,m}, integers m>=3, squared disagreement after k>=0 interactions.
integrity.status: Same-model scientific review only; no independent verification claimed.
integrity.verification: Analytical two-mode covariance proof supplemented by 2060 exact rational finite assertions.

scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic and a fixed finite undirected star with independently uniformly selected hub–leaf edges are assumed.
Time is counted in pair interactions, not wall-clock time; the result does not claim pathwise or high-probability rate.
The m=2 three-node exact 5/8 rate is acknowledged as prior art; the finite-horizon and all-size results concern m>=3.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed and priority against unindexed literature is not established.
title: Exact finite-horizon mean-square decay for randomized pair averaging on stars
